name: @gone-in-space/mod-sdk
description: MANIFEST, NOT A PACKAGE TO INSTALL. The mod toolchain ships OUTSIDE the app's asar (electron-builder.config.cjs copies it into resources/modtools/) and runs in environments that never install the repo root — so the packages it needs have to be DECLARED somewhere both the packager and CI can read, instead of hand-listed in each. This is that declaration, and tests/content/mod_toolchain_deps_test.ts fails the build when the toolchain imports something not listed here. Do NOT `npm install` in this directory: the toolchain shares modules with scripts/, which resolve against the REPO ROOT's node_modules, so a second tree here would be resolved past and quietly ignored.
